name: How do you design outdoor living for year-round California use?

mainEntity.name: How do you design outdoor living for year-round California use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Include heaters (infrared, fire pits), ceiling fans, retractable awnings, outdoor rugs, and weather-resistant furniture to handle cool evenings and mild winters.
